major_concerns: Simulator/validator realism vs. real devices may limit external validity.
Dependency on specific verifiers (Batfish/header-space) could bias results.
Data sourcing/anonymization risk for multi‑vendor corpora.
Automated repair loops can oscillate or produce semantically unsafe but syntactically valid configs.
required_design_repairs: Add multiple verification backends (Batfish + alternative) and report backend disagreement rates.
Specify and publicize anonymization and dataset-licensing procedures; provide sanitized public corpus or clear reproducibility scripts.
Preregister repair-loop safety checks, iteration caps, and conservative fallback policies; log failed/oscillatory repairs.
Include sensitivity analysis for simulator-vs-device mismatch (e.g., spot-checks on vendor emulators if available).

major_concerns: Ethical risk of publishing concrete adversarial prompts and attack recipes.
Simulated human‑gate is an approximation; measured human-workload/latency effects may not generalize.
Adversarial prompt generator may bias defenses if overfitted to its method.
required_design_repairs: Preregister and redact adversarial prompt generation procedures; publish abstracted examples only.
Clearly define and justify human-gate simulation policy and perform sensitivity analyses over gate thresholds.
Use diverse adversary-generation methods and report transferability; include threat-model description and redaction policy.

major_concerns: Proposed measurement requires calibrated human expert time-logging but capability manifest forbids human scientific labour post-lock.
Engineering-cost estimates are subjective and hard to reproduce without standardized protocols.
Risk of publishing vendor‑proprietary rule text or sensitive engineering practices.
required_design_repairs: Redesign to remove/limit real-time human expert labor: use public artifact proxies (open-source validator repos, commit histories, issue trackers) or standardized time-surveys run pre-lock and clearly labeled as external data.

If human measurement is essential, preregister exact rater recruitment, standardization, and IRB/ethics handling; otherwise convert to reproducible surrogate metrics (rule-count, code-diff LOC, automated template-extraction effort).
Ensure all vendor-specific artifacts are sanitized; publish only aggregated cost-effectiveness curves and non-proprietary examples.

major_concerns: Prompt-perturbation space may not reflect realistic operator variability.
Publishing adversarial perturbation patterns risks enabling misuse.
Mitigations (consensus, deterministic decoding) have operational cost/latency tradeoffs that must be quantified.
required_design_repairs: Preregister a systematic, justified perturbation generation procedure and release tooling to reproduce perturbations without exposing exploitable prompts.
Redact or abstract any adversarial examples in outputs; include a safe-disclosure plan.
Include latency/cost measurements for each mitigation and discuss operational tradeoffs; evaluate effectiveness vs. model-call budget constraints.
